functions.name: ticket.status.transition
functions.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

functions.name: ticket.timers.fireTimer
functions.description: Fires a deadline that is due and has not fired: marks it fired and moves the status by its then, recording the outcome; a veto or a missing permission the move meets leaves the status as it is and the deadline fired. A deadline whose until holds is cancelled instead. On a deadline not due, fired already or not started it changes nothing. Any principal who may write the instance may call it; the engine's runner calls it on every due deadline, every sweepMs.

functions.name: ticket.timers.resetTimer
functions.description: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

functions.name: ticket.timers.snoozeTimer
functions.description: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: Signed 64-bit integer; range bounded by JavaScript's safe-integer ceiling.
